notes: SNK 'NEO-GEO ADVANCED ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM INSTRUCTION MANUAL' (US), archive.org scan 'neo-geo-aes-us-manual', OCR text layer; primary. A second scan of the same US manual (archive.org Neo_Geo_AES_Manual_1990_SNK_US, dated 1990) reads the same dimension line with OCR noise ('325mfn ( width)x237mni( depth )x 60mm (height)'); the Japanese manual scan (Neo_Geo_AES_Manual_1990_SNK_JP) shows the same 325/237/60 figures in garbled OCR. No conflict.
Axes labelled by SNK (width, depth, height): body.width=325, body.depth=237, body.height=60. The manual does not say whether projections are excluded: excludes_projections null. No mass is printed.

ports and controls are read from the manual's 'PART NAME & FUNCTION (NEO-GEO unit)' pages (TOP, REAR and FRONT views). Not filed for want of a contract kind: the HEADPHONES jack ('1 piece (Exclusive for stereo headphone)') and the VOLUME slide control. The two control terminals are filed controller_proprietary (the manual names no connector standard). The A/V OUT terminal takes the supplied DIN plug cord (spec: 'A/V output (to be connected through attached din plug cord)', with RGB through a separately sold 21-pin cable), filed multi_av_out. DC IN takes the 'Exclusive AC adapter ... DC9V'; the plug form is not stated, features.power_inlet null.
